reuse.why: Reuses link.assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, but the tree's per-provider link and download functions are copied rather than factored into a shared link/download routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a ~75-line copy of the Akahu/Pluggy link body and downloadFintegraTransactions a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions/downloadPluggyAiTransactions.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, endpoint in server-config and provider key in the bank-sync types, matching where the other providers live.

scope.why: Focused on adding the provider; the small desktop-client edits are forced by the shared provider-key type even though the UI was declared out of scope.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link flow and a fourth copy of the download boilerplate means any future linking rule must again be added in every provider function.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) are open copies of the existing provider functions.
